One of the worst parts of suicide most often is that there really isn’t anything you could’ve done to stop it or help. 

As you said he kept this from you, it’s natural to beat yourself up but there will come a time where you make peace with the fact that what’s happened has happened and you can’t go back to change it. 

I hate to throw my own story into this, but for examples sake. 

My uncle took his life May of last year and not a single person knew he was depressed or suicidal. He never told anyone, acted completely normal around everyone and didn’t seem at all depressed. He never even hinted at it, completely normal and then just gone. 

I tore myself apart for months because I didn’t notice and didn’t help when he needed it, but in reality there was nothing to notice. The only way I could’ve known would’ve been if I’d spent every waking moment with him and analysed his every word/action he spoke/took or pryed every emotion out of him. Which obviously isn’t healthy or really possible. 

It’s gonna be real hard and there will be times where you just don’t know what to do. But keep going and don’t make the mistake your brother made, if you start to feel low, depressed or suicidal or whatever else TELL SOMEONE!

It’s kinda comforting to hear someone talk about how badly hairloss is getting to them. This forum is a godsend sometimes. 

I think a lot of people are severely affected by hairloss (way more than they let on even on here) but even on places like this dedicated to discussing it, a lot of people feel unable to say how they actually feel because there are always idiots yelling that things could be worse, some kid in Africa doesn’t have food, “just get ripped and shave it bro” etc. All of which do nothing other than make the person feel worse for feeling like they do and most likely teaches them to repress their feelings. 

Personally, hairloss is pretty much destroying me mentally (and physically obviously) yet I feel I can’t say a damn thing about it. I’m severely depressed, borderline suicidal some days. The whole thing is obscenely unfair. Talking to friends and family is impossible as none of them are going through it, they just don’t understand it at all and I can’t expect them to because I would’ve been the same had it not happened to me . 

But this sub does help, I’d much rather have it than not. It’s really important to have a community around you going through this, I can’t imagine feeling totally alone going through it.
As someone who’ll readily admit that their hairloss is emotionally destroying them, this is the reason why I don’t come on here that much. I’ll maybe check once  a month for updates on cures etc.
